<thought>We need to determine the number of chemically equivalent hydrogen atoms (unique proton environments) in the compound. The only way to get this information is to obtain the 1H NMR spectrum, which the `proton_nmr_spectra` tool can provide. The tool does not require any arguments, so we will call it directly and then analyze the returned spectrum to count distinct signals, which correspond to unique hydrogen environments.</thought>
<action>proton_nmr_spectra</action>
<action_input>{}</action_input>
